mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, price, stock, category, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{category}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, category = #{category}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, stock, category, status FROM product WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
